ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Affle 3i Limited (formerly Affle (India) Limited) filed an intimation regarding an upcoming one-on-one call with IIFL Capital PMS, affirming that no unpublished price sensitive information would be shared. The key red flag is the reported meeting date of September 28, 2026, which is nearly two years in the future; this strongly suggests a material typo in a regulatory filing, raising concerns about disclosure accuracy. This document primarily details a standard investor relations engagement, but the date error could impact perceptions of the company's diligence in regulatory compliance.
